units.source_text: ……而且，真要是得手的话，写一封信绑在乌鸦的腿上……

en.t: ...and if he really succeeded, he could tie a letter to the crow's leg...

units.source_text: 不，当然是得手以后的事喽……

en.t: No, of course that would be after he had succeeded...

units.source_text: 第一，放走的乌鸦，会不会再被人抓住，可能性微乎其微……

en.t: First of all, the chance that the crow he released would be caught again by someone was almost nil...

units.source_text: 再说，它往何处飞，也无法知道……

en.t: Besides, there was no way to know where it would fly...

units.source_text: 大体上乌鸦的行动半径也非常有限……

en.t: In any case, a crow's range of movement was extremely limited...

units.source_text: 更可怕的是：自己放走了乌鸦，乌鸦群里又有一只乌鸦脚上绑着白纸片，

en.t: What was even more frightening was this: he would have let a crow go, and among the flock there would be a crow with a white slip of paper tied to its leg,

units.source_text: 把这两桩事联系起来，村子里的家伙们肯定能揣测到自己的意图……

en.t: and if the people in the village connected those two things, they would surely be able to guess his intention...

units.source_text: 至今为止好不容易忍受下来的种种，就成了徒劳……

en.t: Everything he had struggled so hard to endure until now would all have been for nothing...
